pedal: Boss RT-2 Rotary Ensemble (mono in: INPUT A; stereo out: OUTPUT A and B), second session
note: Plug OUTPUT B back in. Slow to 7:00 (the rotors stop; wait until the lights stand still), Fast to 5:00. During the take: at ~3 s hold the pedal until the LED turns red (spins up to full speed); at ~18 s hold it again until it turns green (the rotors coast to a stop).

rig.note: Boss RT-2 on its 9 V adapter, second session. Mono in (INPUT A). OUTPUT A -> front input 2, OUTPUT B -> front input 1; both INST, AIR off, pad on, gain fully counter-clockwise. Factory settings assumed (stereo output mode, noise suppressor off, pedal switch Type 1); SPEED jack empty.
